ru.title: Linux исполняется 35 лет: ядро ​​Hobby Kernel теперь поддерживает облако, Android и глобальную киберзащиту
ru.summary: 25 августа 1991 года 21-летний студент Хельсинкского университета разместил скромную заметку в группе Usenet comp.os.minix. «Я делаю (бесплатную) операционную систему (просто хобби, она не будет большой и профессиональной, как GNU) для клонов 386(486) AT», — Линус Торвал
ru.content:
25 августа 1991 года 21-летний студент Хельсинкского университета разместил скромную заметку в группе Usenet comp.os.minix. «Я делаю (бесплатную) операционную систему (просто хобби, не будет такой большой и профессиональной, как gnu) для клонов 386(486) AT», — написал Линус Торвальдс, добавив, что проект назревал с апреля и начал готовиться. Он думал, что строит что-то интересное для себя.

Тридцать пять лет спустя это хобби осталось позади Интернета, публичного облака, Android и каждой системы из списка суперкомпьютеров TOP500.

Торвальдс склонялся к тому, чтобы назвать проект Freax — смесь бесплатного, уродливого и Unix. Когда коллега загрузил первое общедоступное дерево, каталог назывался Linux, и ярлык прижился.

Первый публичный релиз вышел в следующем месяце. То, что начиналось с примерно 10 000 строк кода, выросло за 40 миллионов строк в дереве исходного кода ядра, расширенного сотнями сопровождающих и тысячами участников, а не каким-либо одним поставщиком.

Этот рост теперь связан не только с программным обеспечением, но и с кибербезопасностью. По отраслевым данным, Linux установлен почти на 80 процентах веб-серверов и практически на всех 500 самых быстрых суперкомпьютерах мира. Это самая популярная операционная система в Microsoft Azure.

Почти четыре миллиарда устройств Android используют ядра, производные от Linux. Вертолет НАСА Ingenuity летал на Марс со стеком Linux на коммерческом процессоре Snapdragon, а портативные системы, такие как Steam Deck от Valve, внедрили то же ядро ​​в потребительские игры. Когда выходит ошибка ядра, радиус взрыва больше не составляет несколько 386 клонов. Это критическая инфраструктура.

Ubuntu отметила годовщину публичной публикацией, поблагодарив каждого сопровождающего, участника и защитника, которые превратили побочный проект одного студента в «величайшее совместное технологическое движение в истории».

Linux Foundation провел август, празднуя эту веху, а европейский саммит Open Source в Праге в октябре этого года, как ожидается, будет рассматривать 35-летие как центральное событие. Red Hat, другие коммерческие управляющие и знакомая волна восхвалений пингвинов Тукса представили этот день рождения не как ностальгию, а как доказательство того, что самая важная в мире операционная система по-прежнему создается под открытым небом.

Открытость также является причиной того, что Linux остается под постоянным давлением. Недавние недостатки ядра, в том числе активно используемая локальная ошибка повышения привилегий и ошибка использования после освобождения, которая находилась в дереве почти 18 лет, показывают, как поверхность атаки в 40 миллионов строк вознаграждает как исследователей, так и злоумышленников.

Ответом проекта стал тот же метод, на котором он был построен: публичное рассмотрение, стабильные бэкпорты и растущее стремление к коду, безопасному для памяти. Rust больше не является экспериментом в ядре.

После саммита разработчиков ядра 2025 года сопровождающие объявили его постоянным языком, а Linux 7.0 позже отказался от ярлыка экспериментального. В Rust уже ожидаются новые драйверы в некоторых подсистемах, несмотря на то, что остается обширная кодовая база C.

Торвальдс сказал, что версия его самого 1991 года никогда не предполагала, что эксперимент все еще существует. Следующие 35 лет будут оцениваться не столько тем, останется ли Linux везде, где он уже есть, сколько тем, смогут ли сопровождающие продолжать исправлять, укреплять и обучать планету, которая теперь от него зависит.

articles.title: Multiple OpenSSL Flaws Let Remote Attackers Crash Servers and Corrupt Heap Memory
articles.summary: OpenSSL has issued a fresh security advisory disclosing seven vulnerabilities across its cryptographic library, ranging from a heap-corrupting write bug to memory-exhaustion flaws in its QUIC and DTLS implementations.
articles.content:
OpenSSL has issued a fresh security advisory disclosing seven vulnerabilities across its cryptographic library, ranging from a heap-corrupting write bug to memory-exhaustion flaws in its QUIC and DTLS implementations.

The flaws affect widely deployed branches, including OpenSSL 4.0, 3.6, 3.5, 3.4, and 3.0, and, in some cases, the legacy 1.1.1 line, making patching a priority for any organization running TLS, CMS, or CMP services built on the library.

## OpenSSL Patches 9 Vulnerabilities

The most severe issue, tracked as CVE-2026-63072 and rated Moderate, lives in OpenSSL’s CMS decryption code. When sizing the buffer for an unwrapped key, the library queries the expected output length, but the AES-WRAP-PAD unwrap primitive can actually write and cleanse more bytes than that query reports.

An attacker can take a legitimate encrypted message, flip a single byte in its key-wrap algorithm identifier, and force an 8-byte out-of-bounds heap write whenever the victim calls CMS_decrypt(). Because the write is fixed in size and value, exploitation is reliable and requires no special server configuration, though OpenSSL notes the realistic outcome is heap corruption and a denial of service rather than code execution.

A second Moderate-severity flaw, CVE-2026-63076, affects the Certificate Management Protocol (CMP). During password-based MAC verification, OpenSSL checks only that a protection algorithm parameter is non-null without confirming its actual type, allowing a crafted message to trigger an invalid pointer dereference.

The bug is remotely triggerable by an unauthenticated attacker against any application running a CMP server that accepts PBM-protected messages, and can equally crash a CMP client connecting to a malicious or intercepted server.

The advisory also details five Low-severity issues. CVE-2026-14457 can cause a null pointer dereference in TLS servers or clients configured with Raw Public Keys but no accompanying certificate, when a peer sends the signature_algorithms_cert extension.

CVE-2026-54874 lets an attacker amplify network traffic by roughly 1,200 times, tricking a DTLS endpoint into buffering large read buffers for small forged records tied to a future handshake epoch, straining memory on busy servers.

CVE-2026-63073 stems from CMP response validation passing an untrusted sender distinguished name directly into a logging function as a format string, letting a malicious CMP endpoint crash a client through classic format-string abuse.

CVE-2026-63074 allows unbounded growth of cached extra certificates on long-lived CMP server contexts when rejected messages aren’t cleaned up, risking out-of-memory conditions.

CVE-2026-63075 similarly enables memory exhaustion in OpenSSL’s QUIC stack, where a peer that withholds acknowledgments while forcing ACK-only packets can inflate per-connection memory usage.

Finally, CVE-2026-75803 affects AEAD ciphers ChaCha20-Poly1305 and AES-OCB, where calling EVP_Cipher() on empty ciphertext can report a successful decryption without actually verifying the authentication tag, opening the door to forged messages.

OpenSSL has released fixed versions for every affected branch: 4.0.2, 3.6.4, 3.5.8, 3.4.7, and 3.0.22, with premium support customers on 1.1.1 and 1.0.2 receiving separate backports. None of the flaws touch the FIPS module boundary.

Given the breadth of affected branches and the remote, unauthenticated nature of several bugs, security teams should prioritize inventorying OpenSSL usage across TLS, CMS, and CMP-enabled applications and apply the relevant patched release without delay.

ar.title: تسمح عيوب OpenSSL المتعددة للمهاجمين عن بعد بتعطيل الخوادم وتلف الذاكرة الكومة
ar.summary: أصدرت OpenSSL استشارة أمنية جديدة تكشف عن سبع نقاط ضعف عبر مكتبة التشفير الخاصة بها، بدءًا من خطأ الكتابة المدمر للكومة إلى عيوب استنفاد الذاكرة في تطبيقات QUIC وDTLS.
ar.content:
أصدرت OpenSSL استشارة أمنية جديدة تكشف عن سبع نقاط ضعف عبر مكتبة التشفير الخاصة بها، بدءًا من خطأ الكتابة المدمر للكومة إلى عيوب استنفاد الذاكرة في تطبيقات QUIC وDTLS.

تؤثر العيوب على الفروع المنتشرة على نطاق واسع، بما في ذلك OpenSSL 4.0 و3.6 و3.5 و3.4 و3.0، وفي بعض الحالات، الخط القديم 1.1.1، مما يجعل التصحيح أولوية لأي مؤسسة تقوم بتشغيل خدمات TLS أو CMS أو CMP المبنية على المكتبة.

## OpenSSL تصحيحات 9 نقاط الضعف

المشكلة الأكثر خطورة، والتي يتم تتبعها باسم CVE-2026-63072 وتم تصنيفها على أنها متوسطة، موجودة في كود فك تشفير CMS الخاص بـ OpenSSL. عند تغيير حجم المخزن المؤقت لمفتاح غير ملفوف، تستعلم المكتبة عن طول الإخراج المتوقع، ولكن يمكن لأداة إلغاء التغليف الأولية AES-WRAP-PAD أن تكتب وتنظف بايتات أكثر من تقارير الاستعلام تلك.

يمكن للمهاجم أن يأخذ رسالة مشفرة مشروعة، ويقلب بايتًا واحدًا في معرف خوارزمية التفاف المفتاح الخاص به، ويفرض كتابة كومة تخزينية خارج الحدود بمقدار 8 بايت عندما يستدعي الضحية CMS_decrypt(). نظرًا لأن الكتابة ثابتة من حيث الحجم والقيمة، فإن الاستغلال موثوق به ولا يتطلب أي تكوين خاص للخادم، على الرغم من أن OpenSSL يشير إلى أن النتيجة الواقعية هي تلف الكومة ورفض الخدمة بدلاً من تنفيذ التعليمات البرمجية.

يؤثر الخلل الثاني متوسط ​​الخطورة، CVE-2026-63076، على بروتوكول إدارة الشهادات (CMP). أثناء التحقق من عنوان MAC المستند إلى كلمة المرور، يتحقق OpenSSL فقط من أن معلمة خوارزمية الحماية غير فارغة دون التأكد من نوعها الفعلي، مما يسمح للرسالة المعدة بتشغيل مرجع غير صالح للمؤشر.

يمكن تشغيل الخطأ عن بعد من قبل مهاجم غير مصادق ضد أي تطبيق يقوم بتشغيل خادم CMP يقبل رسائل PBM المحمية، ويمكن أن يؤدي أيضًا إلى تعطل عميل CMP الذي يتصل بخادم ضار أو تم اعتراضه.

توضح الاستشارة أيضًا تفاصيل خمس مشكلات منخفضة الخطورة. يمكن أن يتسبب CVE-2026-14457 في عدم مرجعية مؤشر فارغ في خوادم TLS أو العملاء الذين تم تكوينهم باستخدام المفاتيح العامة الأولية ولكن بدون شهادة مصاحبة، عندما يرسل أحد الأقران ملحق التوقيع_algorithms_cert.

يتيح CVE-2026-54874 للمهاجم تضخيم حركة مرور الشبكة بمقدار 1200 مرة تقريبًا، مما يخدع نقطة نهاية DTLS في تخزين مخازن مؤقتة كبيرة للقراءة مؤقتًا للسجلات الصغيرة المزورة المرتبطة بعصر المصافحة المستقبلية، مما يؤدي إلى إجهاد الذاكرة على الخوادم المزدحمة.

ينبع CVE-2026-63073 من التحقق من صحة استجابة CMP من خلال تمرير الاسم المميز للمرسل غير الموثوق به مباشرةً إلى وظيفة التسجيل كسلسلة تنسيق، مما يسمح لنقطة نهاية CMP الضارة بتعطيل العميل من خلال إساءة استخدام سلسلة التنسيق الكلاسيكية.

يسمح CVE-2026-63074 بنمو غير محدود للشهادات الإضافية المخزنة مؤقتًا في سياقات خادم CMP طويلة الأمد عندما لا يتم تنظيف الرسائل المرفوضة، مما يؤدي إلى المخاطرة بحالات نفاد الذاكرة.

يتيح CVE-2026-63075 بالمثل استنفاد الذاكرة في مكدس QUIC الخاص بـ OpenSSL، حيث يمكن للنظير الذي يحجب الإقرارات أثناء فرض حزم ACK فقط أن يؤدي إلى تضخيم استخدام الذاكرة لكل اتصال.

أخيرًا، يؤثر CVE-2026-75803 على تشفيري EAAD ChaCha20-Poly1305 وAES-OCB، حيث يمكن أن يؤدي استدعاء EVP_Cipher() على نص مشفر فارغ إلى الإبلاغ عن فك تشفير ناجح دون التحقق فعليًا من علامة المصادقة، مما يفتح الباب أمام الرسائل المزيفة.

أصدرت OpenSSL إصدارات ثابتة لكل فرع متأثر: 4.0.2، 3.6.4، 3.5.8، 3.4.7، و3.0.22، مع حصول عملاء الدعم المتميز على 1.1.1 و1.0.2 على منافذ خلفية منفصلة. لا تلمس أي من العيوب حدود وحدة FIPS.

نظرًا لاتساع نطاق الفروع المتأثرة والطبيعة البعيدة وغير المصادق عليها للعديد من الأخطاء، يجب على فرق الأمان إعطاء الأولوية لجرد استخدام OpenSSL عبر التطبيقات التي تدعم TLS وCMS وCMP وتطبيق الإصدار المصحح ذي الصلة دون تأخير.

منع الحوادث بسبب بطء التحقيقات. قم بتعزيز المستوى 1 الخاص بك باستخدام معلومات التهديدات من 15 ألف مركز عمليات تحكم (SOC): قم بدمج بحث TI في مركز عمليات الأمان (SOC) الخاص بك

fr.title: Plusieurs failles OpenSSL permettent aux attaquants distants de planter les serveurs et de corrompre la mémoire du tas
fr.summary: OpenSSL a publié un nouvel avis de sécurité révélant sept vulnérabilités dans sa bibliothèque cryptographique, allant d'un bug d'écriture corrompant le tas à des failles d'épuisement de la mémoire dans ses implémentations QUIC et DTLS.
fr.content:
OpenSSL a publié un nouvel avis de sécurité révélant sept vulnérabilités dans sa bibliothèque cryptographique, allant d'un bug d'écriture corrompant le tas à des failles d'épuisement de la mémoire dans ses implémentations QUIC et DTLS.

Les failles affectent les branches largement déployées, notamment OpenSSL 4.0, 3.6, 3.5, 3.4 et 3.0 et, dans certains cas, l'ancienne gamme 1.1.1, faisant de l'application de correctifs une priorité pour toute organisation exécutant des services TLS, CMS ou CMP construits sur la bibliothèque.

## OpenSSL corrige 9 vulnérabilités

Le problème le plus grave, suivi comme CVE-2026-63072 et classé modéré, réside dans le code de décryptage du CMS d'OpenSSL. Lors du dimensionnement du tampon pour une clé non enveloppée, la bibliothèque interroge la longueur de sortie attendue, mais la primitive de déballage AES-WRAP-PAD peut en fait écrire et nettoyer plus d'octets que ce que rapporte la requête.

Un attaquant peut prendre un message chiffré légitime, retourner un seul octet dans son identifiant d'algorithme d'enveloppement de clé et forcer une écriture hors limites de 8 octets chaque fois que la victime appelle CMS_decrypt(). Étant donné que l'écriture est fixe en taille et en valeur, l'exploitation est fiable et ne nécessite aucune configuration de serveur spéciale, bien qu'OpenSSL note que le résultat réaliste est une corruption du tas et un déni de service plutôt qu'une exécution de code.

Une deuxième faille de gravité modérée, CVE-2026-63076, affecte le protocole de gestion des certificats (CMP). Lors de la vérification MAC basée sur un mot de passe, OpenSSL vérifie uniquement qu'un paramètre d'algorithme de protection n'est pas nul sans confirmer son type réel, permettant à un message contrefait de déclencher un déréférencement de pointeur non valide.

Le bug peut être déclenché à distance par un attaquant non authentifié contre toute application exécutant un serveur CMP qui accepte les messages protégés par PBM, et peut également faire planter un client CMP se connectant à un serveur malveillant ou intercepté.

L'avis détaille également cinq problèmes de faible gravité. CVE-2026-14457 peut provoquer un déréférencement de pointeur nul dans les serveurs ou clients TLS configurés avec des clés publiques brutes mais sans certificat associé, lorsqu'un homologue envoie l'extension signature_algorithms_cert.

CVE-2026-54874 permet à un attaquant d'amplifier le trafic réseau d'environ 1 200 fois, incitant un point de terminaison DTLS à mettre en mémoire tampon de grands tampons de lecture pour de petits enregistrements falsifiés liés à une future époque de prise de contact, mettant ainsi à rude épreuve la mémoire des serveurs occupés.

CVE-2026-63073 découle de la validation de la réponse CMP transmettant un nom distinctif d'expéditeur non fiable directement dans une fonction de journalisation en tant que chaîne de format, permettant à un point de terminaison CMP malveillant de planter un client via un abus classique de chaîne de format.

CVE-2026-63074 permet une croissance illimitée des certificats supplémentaires mis en cache sur des contextes de serveur CMP de longue durée lorsque les messages rejetés ne sont pas nettoyés, ce qui risque de provoquer des conditions de mémoire insuffisante.

CVE-2026-63075 permet également l'épuisement de la mémoire dans la pile QUIC d'OpenSSL, où un homologue qui retient les accusés de réception tout en forçant les paquets ACK uniquement peut gonfler l'utilisation de la mémoire par connexion.

Enfin, CVE-2026-75803 affecte les chiffrements AEAD ChaCha20-Poly1305 et AES-OCB, où l'appel de EVP_Cipher() sur un texte chiffré vide peut signaler un déchiffrement réussi sans réellement vérifier la balise d'authentification, ouvrant ainsi la porte à de faux messages.

OpenSSL a publié des versions corrigées pour chaque branche concernée : 4.0.2, 3.6.4, 3.5.8, 3.4.7 et 3.0.22, les clients du support premium sur 1.1.1 et 1.0.2 recevant des rétroportages distincts. Aucune des failles ne touche les limites du module FIPS.

Compte tenu de l'étendue des branches affectées et de la nature distante et non authentifiée de plusieurs bogues, les équipes de sécurité doivent donner la priorité à l'inventaire de l'utilisation d'OpenSSL dans les applications compatibles TLS, CMS et CMP et appliquer sans délai la version corrigée appropriée.

de.title: Mehrere OpenSSL-Fehler führen dazu, dass Remote-Angreifer Server zum Absturz bringen und den Heap-Speicher beschädigen
de.summary: OpenSSL hat eine neue Sicherheitswarnung herausgegeben, die sieben Schwachstellen in seiner kryptografischen Bibliothek aufdeckt, die von einem Heap-beschädigenden Schreibfehler bis hin zu Speicherauslastungsfehlern in seinen QUIC- und DTLS-Implementierungen reichen.
de.content:
OpenSSL hat eine neue Sicherheitswarnung herausgegeben, die sieben Schwachstellen in seiner kryptografischen Bibliothek aufdeckt, die von einem Heap-beschädigenden Schreibfehler bis hin zu Speicherauslastungsfehlern in seinen QUIC- und DTLS-Implementierungen reichen.

Die Mängel betreffen weit verbreitete Zweige, darunter OpenSSL 4.0, 3.6, 3.5, 3.4 und 3.0 sowie in einigen Fällen die ältere 1.1.1-Reihe, sodass das Patchen für jede Organisation, die auf der Bibliothek basierende TLS-, CMS- oder CMP-Dienste betreibt, Priorität hat.

## OpenSSL behebt 9 Schwachstellen

Das schwerwiegendste Problem, das als CVE-2026-63072 verfolgt und als „Mittel“ eingestuft wird, liegt im CMS-Entschlüsselungscode von OpenSSL. Bei der Größe des Puffers für einen nicht umschlossenen Schlüssel fragt die Bibliothek die erwartete Ausgabelänge ab, aber das AES-WRAP-PAD-Unwrap-Primitiv kann tatsächlich mehr Bytes schreiben und bereinigen, als diese Abfrage meldet.

Ein Angreifer kann eine legitime verschlüsselte Nachricht nehmen, ein einzelnes Byte in der Kennung des Key-Wrap-Algorithmus umdrehen und einen 8-Byte-Heap-Schreibvorgang außerhalb des zulässigen Bereichs erzwingen, wann immer das Opfer CMS_decrypt() aufruft. Da der Schreibvorgang in Größe und Wert festgelegt ist, ist die Ausnutzung zuverlässig und erfordert keine spezielle Serverkonfiguration. OpenSSL weist jedoch darauf hin, dass das realistische Ergebnis eher eine Heap-Beschädigung und einen Denial-of-Service als eine Codeausführung ist.

Ein zweiter Fehler mittlerer Schwere, CVE-2026-63076, betrifft das Certificate Management Protocol (CMP). Bei der kennwortbasierten MAC-Überprüfung prüft OpenSSL nur, ob ein Schutzalgorithmus-Parameter ungleich Null ist, ohne seinen tatsächlichen Typ zu bestätigen, sodass eine manipulierte Nachricht eine ungültige Zeiger-Dereferenzierung auslösen kann.

Der Fehler kann von einem nicht authentifizierten Angreifer aus der Ferne gegen jede Anwendung ausgelöst werden, die einen CMP-Server ausführt, der PBM-geschützte Nachrichten akzeptiert, und kann gleichermaßen einen CMP-Client zum Absturz bringen, der eine Verbindung zu einem böswilligen oder abgefangenen Server herstellt.

Das Advisory beschreibt außerdem fünf Probleme mit geringem Schweregrad. CVE-2026-14457 kann eine Nullzeiger-Dereferenzierung in TLS-Servern oder -Clients verursachen, die mit rohen öffentlichen Schlüsseln, aber ohne zugehöriges Zertifikat konfiguriert sind, wenn ein Peer die Signature_algorithms_cert-Erweiterung sendet.

Mit CVE-2026-54874 kann ein Angreifer den Netzwerkverkehr um etwa das 1.200-fache verstärken und einen DTLS-Endpunkt dazu verleiten, große Lesepuffer für kleine gefälschte Datensätze zu puffern, die an eine zukünftige Handshake-Epoche gebunden sind, was den Speicher auf ausgelasteten Servern belastet.

CVE-2026-63073 ist auf die CMP-Antwortvalidierung zurückzuführen, bei der ein nicht vertrauenswürdiger Absender-Distinguished Name direkt als Formatzeichenfolge an eine Protokollierungsfunktion übergeben wird, was dazu führt, dass ein böswilliger CMP-Endpunkt einen Client durch klassischen Formatzeichenfolgenmissbrauch zum Absturz bringt.

CVE-2026-63074 ermöglicht ein unbegrenztes Wachstum zwischengespeicherter zusätzlicher Zertifikate in langlebigen CMP-Serverkontexten, wenn abgelehnte Nachrichten nicht bereinigt werden, wodurch die Gefahr von Speichermangel besteht.

CVE-2026-63075 führt ebenfalls zu einer Speichererschöpfung im QUIC-Stack von OpenSSL, wo ein Peer, der Bestätigungen zurückhält und gleichzeitig nur ACK-Pakete erzwingt, die Speichernutzung pro Verbindung in die Höhe treiben kann.

Schließlich betrifft CVE-2026-75803 die AEAD-Verschlüsselungen ChaCha20-Poly1305 und AES-OCB, bei denen der Aufruf von EVP_Cipher() für leeren Chiffretext eine erfolgreiche Entschlüsselung melden kann, ohne das Authentifizierungs-Tag tatsächlich zu überprüfen, was gefälschten Nachrichten Tür und Tor öffnet.

OpenSSL hat für jeden betroffenen Zweig feste Versionen veröffentlicht: 4.0.2, 3.6.4, 3.5.8, 3.4.7 und 3.0.22, wobei Premium-Support-Kunden für 1.1.1 und 1.0.2 separate Backports erhalten. Keiner der Mängel berührt die FIPS-Modulgrenze.

Angesichts der Breite der betroffenen Zweige und der entfernten, nicht authentifizierten Natur mehrerer Fehler sollten Sicherheitsteams der Inventarisierung der OpenSSL-Nutzung in TLS-, CMS- und CMP-fähigen Anwendungen Priorität einräumen und die entsprechende gepatchte Version unverzüglich anwenden.

es.title: Múltiples fallas de OpenSSL permiten que atacantes remotos bloqueen servidores y corrompan la memoria del montón
es.summary: OpenSSL ha emitido un nuevo aviso de seguridad que revela siete vulnerabilidades en su biblioteca criptográfica, que van desde un error de escritura que corrompe el montón hasta fallas de agotamiento de la memoria en sus implementaciones QUIC y DTLS.
es.content:
OpenSSL ha emitido un nuevo aviso de seguridad que revela siete vulnerabilidades en su biblioteca criptográfica, que van desde un error de escritura que corrompe el montón hasta fallas de agotamiento de la memoria en sus implementaciones QUIC y DTLS.

Las fallas afectan a ramas ampliamente implementadas, incluidas OpenSSL 4.0, 3.6, 3.5, 3.4 y 3.0 y, en algunos casos, la línea heredada 1.1.1, lo que hace que la aplicación de parches sea una prioridad para cualquier organización que ejecute servicios TLS, CMS o CMP integrados en la biblioteca.

## OpenSSL parchea 9 vulnerabilidades

El problema más grave, identificado como CVE-2026-63072 y clasificado como Moderado, se encuentra en el código de descifrado CMS de OpenSSL. Al dimensionar el búfer para una clave desenvuelta, la biblioteca consulta la longitud de salida esperada, pero la primitiva de desenvolvimiento AES-WRAP-PAD en realidad puede escribir y limpiar más bytes de los que informa esa consulta.

Un atacante puede tomar un mensaje cifrado legítimo, invertir un solo byte en su identificador de algoritmo de ajuste de clave y forzar una escritura en montón fuera de límites de 8 bytes cada vez que la víctima llame a CMS_decrypt(). Debido a que la escritura tiene un tamaño y valor fijos, la explotación es confiable y no requiere una configuración especial del servidor, aunque OpenSSL señala que el resultado realista es corrupción del montón y denegación de servicio en lugar de ejecución de código.

Una segunda falla de gravedad moderada, CVE-2026-63076, afecta el Protocolo de gestión de certificados (CMP). Durante la verificación de MAC basada en contraseña, OpenSSL solo verifica que un parámetro del algoritmo de protección no sea nulo sin confirmar su tipo real, lo que permite que un mensaje elaborado active una desreferencia de puntero no válida.

El error lo puede desencadenar de forma remota un atacante no autenticado contra cualquier aplicación que ejecute un servidor CMP que acepte mensajes protegidos por PBM, y también puede bloquear un cliente CMP que se conecta a un servidor malicioso o interceptado.

El aviso también detalla cinco problemas de baja gravedad. CVE-2026-14457 puede provocar una desreferencia de puntero nulo en servidores TLS o clientes configurados con claves públicas sin formato pero sin certificado adjunto, cuando un par envía la extensión Signature_algorithms_cert.

CVE-2026-54874 permite a un atacante amplificar el tráfico de red aproximadamente 1200 veces, engañando a un punto final DTLS para que almacene grandes búferes de lectura para pequeños registros falsificados vinculados a una futura época de protocolo de enlace, lo que sobrecarga la memoria en servidores ocupados.

CVE-2026-63073 surge de la validación de la respuesta de CMP que pasa un nombre distinguido de remitente que no es de confianza directamente a una función de registro como una cadena de formato, lo que permite que un punto final de CMP malicioso bloquee a un cliente mediante el abuso clásico de cadenas de formato.

CVE-2026-63074 permite el crecimiento ilimitado de certificados adicionales almacenados en caché en contextos de servidor CMP de larga duración cuando los mensajes rechazados no se limpian, lo que corre el riesgo de sufrir condiciones de falta de memoria.

De manera similar, CVE-2026-63075 habilita el agotamiento de la memoria en la pila QUIC de OpenSSL, donde un par que retiene los reconocimientos mientras fuerza paquetes de solo ACK puede inflar el uso de memoria por conexión.

Finalmente, CVE-2026-75803 afecta los cifrados AEAD ChaCha20-Poly1305 y AES-OCB, donde llamar a EVP_Cipher() en un texto cifrado vacío puede informar un descifrado exitoso sin verificar realmente la etiqueta de autenticación, abriendo la puerta a mensajes falsificados.

OpenSSL ha lanzado versiones fijas para cada rama afectada: 4.0.2, 3.6.4, 3.5.8, 3.4.7 y 3.0.22, y los clientes de soporte premium en 1.1.1 y 1.0.2 reciben backports separados. Ninguno de los defectos toca el límite del módulo FIPS.

Dada la amplitud de las sucursales afectadas y la naturaleza remota y no autenticada de varios errores, los equipos de seguridad deben priorizar el inventario del uso de OpenSSL en aplicaciones habilitadas para TLS, CMS y CMP y aplicar la versión parcheada correspondiente sin demora.

tr.title: Çoklu OpenSSL Kusurları Uzak Saldırganların Sunucuları Çökmesine ve Yığın Belleğinin Bozulmasına İzin Verir
tr.summary: OpenSSL, kriptografik kütüphanesindeki, yığın bozan yazma hatalarından QUIC ve DTLS uygulamalarındaki bellek tüketme kusurlarına kadar uzanan yedi güvenlik açığını açıklayan yeni bir güvenlik tavsiyesi yayınladı.
tr.content:
OpenSSL, kriptografik kütüphanesindeki, yığın bozan yazma hatalarından QUIC ve DTLS uygulamalarındaki bellek tüketme kusurlarına kadar uzanan yedi güvenlik açığını açıklayan yeni bir güvenlik tavsiyesi yayınladı.

Kusurlar, OpenSSL 4.0, 3.6, 3.5, 3.4 ve 3.0 dahil olmak üzere geniş çapta dağıtılan şubeleri ve bazı durumlarda eski 1.1.1 hattını etkileyerek, kütüphane üzerine kurulu TLS, CMS veya CMP hizmetlerini çalıştıran tüm kuruluşlar için yama uygulamayı bir öncelik haline getiriyor.

## OpenSSL 9 Güvenlik Açığı Yamasını Düzeltiyor

CVE-2026-63072 olarak izlenen ve Orta Derecede olarak derecelendirilen en ciddi sorun, OpenSSL'in CMS şifre çözme kodunda yaşanıyor. Sarılmamış bir anahtar için arabelleği boyutlandırırken, kitaplık beklenen çıktı uzunluğunu sorgular, ancak AES-WRAP-PAD paket açma ilkel öğesi aslında bu sorgu raporlarından daha fazla bayt yazabilir ve temizleyebilir.

Bir saldırgan meşru bir şifrelenmiş mesajı alabilir, anahtar sarma algoritması tanımlayıcısında tek bir baytı çevirebilir ve kurban CMS_decrypt() işlevini çağırdığında 8 baytlık sınır dışı yığın yazmaya zorlayabilir. Yazma boyutu ve değeri sabit olduğundan, istismar güvenilirdir ve özel bir sunucu yapılandırması gerektirmez; ancak OpenSSL, gerçekçi sonucun kod yürütme yerine yığın bozulması ve hizmet reddi olduğunu belirtir.

Orta düzeyde önem derecesine sahip ikinci bir kusur olan CVE-2026-63076, Sertifika Yönetimi Protokolünü (CMP) etkiler. Parola tabanlı MAC doğrulaması sırasında OpenSSL, gerçek türünü onaylamadan yalnızca bir koruma algoritması parametresinin boş olmadığını kontrol ederek hazırlanmış bir mesajın geçersiz bir işaretçi referansını tetiklemesine izin verir.

Hata, kimliği doğrulanmamış bir saldırgan tarafından, PBM korumalı mesajları kabul eden bir CMP sunucusu çalıştıran herhangi bir uygulamaya karşı uzaktan tetiklenebilir ve kötü amaçlı veya ele geçirilen bir sunucuya bağlanan bir CMP istemcisinin de aynı şekilde çökmesine neden olabilir.

Tavsiye belgesinde ayrıca beş adet Düşük önem dereceli sorun ayrıntılı olarak anlatılmaktadır. CVE-2026-14457, bir eş,signum_algorithms_cert uzantısını gönderdiğinde, TLS sunucularında veya Ham Genel Anahtarlarla yapılandırılmış ancak eşlik eden sertifika bulunmayan istemcilerde boş işaretçi referansına neden olabilir.

CVE-2026-54874, bir saldırganın ağ trafiğini yaklaşık 1.200 kat artırmasına, bir DTLS uç noktasını kandırarak gelecekteki bir el sıkışma dönemine bağlı küçük sahte kayıtlar için büyük okuma arabelleklerini ara belleğe almasına ve meşgul sunucularda belleği zorlamasına olanak tanır.

CVE-2026-63073, güvenilmeyen bir gönderenin ayırt edici adını doğrudan bir günlük işlevine bir biçim dizesi olarak geçirerek CMP yanıt doğrulamasından kaynaklanır ve kötü amaçlı bir CMP uç noktasının klasik biçim dizesi kötüye kullanımı yoluyla bir istemciyi çökertmesine olanak tanır.

CVE-2026-63074, reddedilen iletiler temizlenmediğinde uzun ömürlü CMP sunucusu bağlamlarında önbelleğe alınmış ekstra sertifikaların sınırsız büyümesine olanak tanır ve yetersiz bellek koşulları riskini doğurur.

CVE-2026-63075 benzer şekilde OpenSSL'in QUIC yığınında bellek tükenmesine olanak tanır; burada yalnızca ACK paketlerini zorlarken onayları saklayan bir eş, bağlantı başına bellek kullanımını artırabilir.

Son olarak, CVE-2026-75803, AEAD şifreleri ChaCha20-Poly1305 ve AES-OCB'yi etkiler; burada boş şifreli metinde EVP_Cipher() çağrılması, kimlik doğrulama etiketini gerçekten doğrulamadan başarılı bir şifre çözme raporlayabilir ve sahte mesajlara kapıyı açabilir.

OpenSSL, etkilenen her şube için sabit sürümler yayınladı: 4.0.2, 3.6.4, 3.5.8, 3.4.7 ve 3.0.22; 1.1.1 ve 1.0.2'deki premium destek müşterileri ayrı destek hizmetleri alıyor. Kusurların hiçbiri FIPS modülü sınırına dokunmuyor.

Etkilenen şubelerin genişliği ve birçok hatanın uzaktan, doğrulanmamış doğası göz önüne alındığında, güvenlik ekiplerinin TLS, CMS ve CMP özellikli uygulamalarda OpenSSL kullanımının envanterini çıkarmaya öncelik vermesi ve ilgili yamalı sürümü gecikmeden uygulaması gerekir.

ru.title: Множественные недостатки OpenSSL позволяют удаленным злоумышленникам аварийно завершать работу серверов и повреждать динамическую память
ru.summary: OpenSSL выпустила новую рекомендацию по безопасности, раскрывающую семь уязвимостей в своей криптографической библиотеке: от ошибки записи, приводящей к повреждению кучи, до ошибок, связанных с исчерпанием памяти в реализациях QUIC и DTLS.
ru.content:
OpenSSL выпустила новую рекомендацию по безопасности, раскрывающую семь уязвимостей в своей криптографической библиотеке: от ошибки записи, приводящей к повреждению кучи, до ошибок, связанных с исчерпанием памяти в реализациях QUIC и DTLS.

Недостатки затрагивают широко распространенные ветки, включая OpenSSL 4.0, 3.6, 3.5, 3.4 и 3.0, а также, в некоторых случаях, устаревшую линейку 1.1.1, что делает исправление приоритетом для любой организации, использующей службы TLS, CMS или CMP, созданные на основе библиотеки.

## OpenSSL исправляет 9 уязвимостей

Самая серьезная проблема, отслеживаемая как CVE-2026-63072 и получившая средний уровень, связана с кодом расшифровки CMS OpenSSL. При определении размера буфера для развернутого ключа библиотека запрашивает ожидаемую длину вывода, но примитив развертывания AES-WRAP-PAD может фактически записать и очистить больше байтов, чем сообщает запрос.

Злоумышленник может взять законное зашифрованное сообщение, перевернуть один байт в его идентификаторе алгоритма переноса ключей и принудительно записать 8-байтовую кучу за пределами границ всякий раз, когда жертва вызывает CMS_decrypt(). Поскольку размер и стоимость записи фиксированы, эксплуатация надежна и не требует специальной настройки сервера, хотя OpenSSL отмечает, что реалистичным результатом будет повреждение кучи и отказ в обслуживании, а не выполнение кода.

Вторая уязвимость средней степени серьезности, CVE-2026-63076, затрагивает протокол управления сертификатами (CMP). Во время проверки MAC на основе пароля OpenSSL проверяет только то, что параметр алгоритма защиты не равен нулю, без подтверждения его фактического типа, что позволяет созданному сообщению инициировать разыменование недопустимого указателя.

Эта ошибка может быть удаленно вызвана неаутентифицированным злоумышленником в отношении любого приложения, на котором работает сервер CMP, который принимает сообщения, защищенные PBM, и в равной степени может привести к сбою клиента CMP, подключающегося к вредоносному или перехваченному серверу.

В рекомендациях также подробно описываются пять проблем низкой степени серьезности. CVE-2026-14457 может вызвать разыменование нулевого указателя на серверах или клиентах TLS, настроенных с использованием необработанных открытых ключей, но без сопутствующего сертификата, когда одноранговый узел отправляет расширение Signature_algorithms_cert.

CVE-2026-54874 позволяет злоумышленнику увеличить сетевой трафик примерно в 1200 раз, обманом заставив конечную точку DTLS буферизовать большие буферы чтения для небольших поддельных записей, привязанных к будущей эпохе рукопожатия, что приводит к перегрузке памяти на загруженных серверах.

CVE-2026-63073 связан с проверкой ответа CMP, передающей отличительное имя недоверенного отправителя непосредственно в функцию ведения журнала в виде строки формата, что позволяет злонамеренной конечной точке CMP привести к сбою клиента из-за классического злоупотребления строкой форматирования.

CVE-2026-63074 допускает неограниченный рост количества кэшированных дополнительных сертификатов в долгоживущих контекстах сервера CMP, когда отклоненные сообщения не очищаются, что может привести к нехватке памяти.

CVE-2026-63075 аналогичным образом приводит к исчерпанию памяти в стеке QUIC OpenSSL, где партнер, который сдерживает подтверждения и принудительно отправляет пакеты только ACK, может увеличить использование памяти для каждого соединения.

Наконец, CVE-2026-75803 затрагивает шифры AEAD ChaCha20-Poly1305 и AES-OCB, где вызов EVP_Cipher() для пустого зашифрованного текста может сообщить об успешном дешифровании без фактической проверки тега аутентификации, открывая дверь для поддельных сообщений.

OpenSSL выпустил исправленные версии для каждой затронутой ветки: 4.0.2, 3.6.4, 3.5.8, 3.4.7 и 3.0.22, при этом клиенты премиум-поддержки версий 1.1.1 и 1.0.2 получают отдельные бэкпорты. Ни один из дефектов не затрагивает границы модуля FIPS.

Учитывая широту затронутых ветвей и удаленный характер некоторых ошибок без аутентификации, группам безопасности следует уделить приоритетное внимание инвентаризации использования OpenSSL в приложениях с поддержкой TLS, CMS и CMP и без промедления применить соответствующую исправленную версию.

articles.title: Researcher Discloses Five High-Risk Vulnerabilities in Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN
articles.summary: A security researcher has disclosed five vulnerabilities that he responsibly reported to Palo Alto Networks, affecting GlobalProtect, the VPN and endpoint agent used across thousands of enterprise networks worldwide.
articles.content:
A security researcher has disclosed five vulnerabilities that he responsibly reported to Palo Alto Networks, affecting GlobalProtect, the VPN and endpoint agent used across thousands of enterprise networks worldwide.

The disclosure, published through a dedicated research site, has reignited debate over how vendors handle vulnerability reports even when researchers follow coordinated disclosure norms.

According to the researcher Martijn van Ramesdonk, the five issues were originally submitted to Palo Alto Networks in early April 2026, and two of them were eventually folded into CVE-2026-0251, a set of local privilege escalation flaws in the GlobalProtect app.

Palo Alto’s own advisory confirms that the bugs allow a local, low-privileged user to escalate to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM on Windows and to root on macOS and Linux, giving an attacker who already has a foothold on an endpoint the ability to run arbitrary commands with full administrative control.

The National Vulnerability Database lists a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.8, reflecting the seriousness of local privilege escalation on a widely deployed VPN client.

Beyond privilege escalation, the researcher says his work also uncovered a method to recover a user’s Active Directory password directly from the endpoint by abusing privileged GlobalProtect components, a finding with far more direct implications for corporate identity infrastructure than a typical local exploit.

What makes this case notable is not just the technical severity but the researcher’s account of the disclosure journey itself. He says the two vulnerabilities behind CVE-2026-0251 were initially patched by Palo Alto Networks without any notification to him and without credit in the accompanying advisory, prompting him to push back publicly.

Two further vulnerabilities were reportedly deemed out of scope for the vendor’s bug bounty program, while a fifth remains unpatched and undisclosed while remediation work continues.

The researcher describes more than 40 emails exchanged with Palo Alto’s Product Security Incident Response Team and multiple missed or shifting disclosure deadlines stretched across several months, a process he characterizes as symptomatic of a broken coordination model rather than a technical failure.

Four proof-of-concept exploits tied to the disclosed flaws are now publicly available, while the fifth is being withheld pending an official fix from Palo Alto Networks. Affected versions span multiple GlobalProtect 6.0, 6.2, and 6.3 branches on Windows, macOS, and Linux, and Palo Alto has published patched builds for each, though the vendor has stated it is not aware of active exploitation in the wild.

Endpoint and VPN software occupies a privileged position inside enterprise networks, often bridging directly into Active Directory and identity systems, which makes local privilege escalation and credential-recovery bugs in these products disproportionately dangerous compared to flaws in less trusted applications.

The researcher’s broader point, that artificial intelligence is accelerating vulnerability discovery faster than vendors can validate, patch, and credit findings, points to a looming bottleneck: finding bugs is getting easier, but responsible, well-coordinated disclosure still depends on human judgment, mature internal processes, and accountability that no automation can substitute.

articles.title: Zimbra Collaboration Suite Vulnerability Actively Exploited in the Wild
articles.summary: CERT Polska has warned that threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-73570, a critical OS command-injection vulnerability in Zimbra Collaboration Suite that allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands as the zim
articles.content:
CERT Polska has warned that threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-73570, a critical OS command-injection vulnerability in Zimbra Collaboration Suite that allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands as the zimbra user.

The vulnerability affects Zimbra installations in which the SNMP trap service is enabled via the snmp_notify parameter and the swatchdog service is running.

Since swatchdog is enabled by default, exposed servers with SNMP notifications configured may face a heightened risk of compromise. Successful exploitation could give attackers a foothold on vulnerable mail servers without requiring valid credentials.

From there, attackers may execute malicious commands, create or modify files, deploy web shells, steal email data, establish persistence, or use the compromised server to target other systems within an organization.

## Zimbra Collaboration Suite Vulnerability Exploited

CERT Polska said the issue has already been observed in an ongoing exploitation campaign. Organizations using Zimbra Collaboration Suite should therefore treat the vulnerability as an immediate incident-response and patch-management priority rather than a routine software update.

Zimbra fixed CVE-2026-73570 in version 10.1.20. Administrators should verify the installed Zimbra version and upgrade affected systems to a patched release as soon as possible.

Systems that cannot be updated immediately should be reviewed for whether SNMP trap functionality is necessary and whether the snmp_notify configuration is enabled.

Security teams should also inspect Zimbra logs for suspicious changes in service status. Relevant entries may show an unfamiliar service or command payload changing from “stopped” to “running,” or from “running” to “stopped.”

These events may indicate that an attacker used the vulnerable component to trigger malicious commands through the swatchdog service.

Administrators should specifically review /var/log/zimbra.log for unexpected “Service status change” records. Any service names, command strings, or payloads that do not match normal operational activity should be investigated.

CERT Polska also recommends checking for recently created files owned by the zimbra user. The highest-priority directories include /opt/zimbra/jetty/webapps/, /opt/zimbra/jetty_base/webapps/, and /tmp/.

Web application directories are especially important because attackers often place JSP-based web shells or other malicious application files there to maintain remote access after initial exploitation.

Files created or modified in the past 30 days should be reviewed for unusual names, obfuscated code, unexpected archive files, executable scripts, unauthorized JSP files, and outbound network activity associated with the Zimbra server.

If signs of compromise are found, organizations should isolate the affected server, preserve logs and suspicious files for forensic analysis, rotate potentially exposed credentials, and investigate connected systems for lateral movement. CERT Polska has requested that evidence of suspected exploitation be reported to its incident-response team.

The active exploitation of CVE-2026-73570 highlights the continued targeting of internet-facing email infrastructure. Prompt patching, log review, and web-shell hunting are essential to reduce the risk of a full Zimbra server compromise.

articles.summary: A criminal service is hiding behind a website that appears to offer Adobe Acrobat Reader. The site, acrobatreaderonline.com, is not a document service. Instead, it appears to expose an operator panel for building and managing attacks against Windows
articles.content:
A criminal service is hiding behind a website that appears to offer Adobe Acrobat Reader. The site, acrobatreaderonline.com, is not a document service. Instead, it appears to expose an operator panel for building and managing attacks against Windows users.

The campaign uses a familiar trick: a trusted-looking document or payment theme leads a target toward a harmful download.

Earlier activity tied to the same infrastructure used a Windows batch, or .bat, file through a WebDAV remote folder, turning a PDF or boleto lure into a possible malware entry point.

Researchers at Clandestine identified the operation during an open-source review on August 23, finding a live malware-as-a-service, or MaaS, panel behind the Adobe-themed domain.

Clandestine said in a report shared with Cyber Security News (CSN) that the site was not an Adobe reader portal and should not be treated as safe.

The discovery shows how a convincing brand imitation can move from a phishing lure to a working criminal platform. It contains features for collecting victim data, managing files and preparing malware modules, lowering the barrier for operators.

## New Malware-as-a-service Leveraging Adobe-themed Domain

The domain creates a serious trust problem for people searching for a PDF reader, opening document links or responding to payment messages.

Its public page uses the title “SecureWorkspace WebPanel,” while an application route identifies itself as “Kaido Panel.” Neither is a legitimate document viewer or cloud document service.

Behind the landing page, researchers found protected endpoints for a command-and-control interface and a live SignalR communication hub.

Unauthenticated requests returned a bearer-authentication challenge, showing the site is more than a static decoy. It is designed to give authorized operators access to backend functions.

Public JavaScript exposed references to a builder, file manager, authentication refresh function and a section labelled loot. The code listed modules connected with information theft, banking overlays, PIX payments and boleto lures.

That mix makes the operation relevant to Windows users and organizations processing financial documents. The documented delivery chain shows why a file extension can matter as much as a document name.

Historical sandbox records linked Kaido infrastructure to a WebDAV loader using a .bat dropper and the Windows WebClient service. Similar Windows File Explorer WebDAV abuse can open remote content in ways that appear less suspicious than a conventional download.

A batch file can run commands when a victim opens it, so it should never be assumed to be a harmless document. Users should question supposed PDF files with unusual extensions, shortcuts or download prompts.

Recent fake Adobe document campaigns have likewise used familiar sharing language to persuade recipients to run unwanted software.

## Infrastructure and Defensive Actions

The domain was registered in June 2026 and uses Cloudflare-hosted infrastructure. Its nameservers match those used by kaido.sh, a related domain seen earlier.

At the time of review, only the www host resolved; several likely service names did not. A future address assigned to those names may signal a command-and-control shift.

This justifies immediate checks. Organizations should block the identified domains across DNS, web proxies and email controls, then examine logs for requests to them.

Teams should look for unexpected WebClient activity and the listed local cache artifact, which can reveal WebDAV-based delivery.

Users should download Acrobat Reader only from Adobe’s official domain, not lookalike sites or unsolicited links. Security teams should avoid logging into the panel or executing files obtained from it.

The risk fits a pattern seen in malware disguised as trusted apps, where recognizable names weaken a user’s caution. For defenders, combine domain blocking with alerts for suspicious remote-folder connections and script launches.

Preserve relevant telemetry before action, check whether artifacts appear on endpoints, and report the infrastructure to the registrar, hosting provider and national response teams.

A Windows AllaKore malware operation illustrates how PDF lures, WebDAV and batch scripts can form a multi-stage Windows compromise.

articles.title: Iran-Linked Hackers Force UK Power Plant Offline in Unprecedented Four-Day Cyberattack
articles.summary: A cyberattack attributed to hackers linked to Iran forced a British power plant offline for four consecutive days last month, marking what officials describe as the first successful attack of its kind against UK energy infrastructure.
articles.content:
A cyberattack attributed to hackers linked to Iran forced a British power plant offline for four consecutive days last month, marking what officials describe as the first successful attack of its kind against UK energy infrastructure.

The incident, first reported by The Telegraph, has raised fresh alarm over the vulnerability of critical infrastructure amid heightened tensions between the UK, US, and Tehran.

According to the UK government, the affected facility was a small-scale energy generator, and officials have stressed that at no point was there any risk to the broader national grid.

A spokesperson for the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) said the incident “impacted a small-scale energy generator” and reiterated that “the UK has a highly resilient energy system,” adding that the government works closely with the energy sector to maintain the highest security standards.

A government source went further, telling reporters that the targeted site was “less than a rounding error compared to grid capacity” and fell well below the legal thresholds that require significant generators to report cyber incidents.

Despite the reassurances, security analysts view the attack as a notable escalation. articles.title: Felons, Fraudsters Flog Offensive Cybersecurity Startup
articles.summary: A cybersecurity startup dangling millions of dollars to acquire zero-day security vulnerabilities in popular software is run by a pair of far-right conspiracy theorists and convicted felons whose most recent ventures included fake intelligence compan
articles.content:
A cybersecurity startup dangling millions of dollars to acquire zero-day security vulnerabilities in popular software is run by a pair of far-right conspiracy theorists and convicted felons whose most recent ventures included fake intelligence companies and a now-defunct AI-based lobbying platform they operated under assumed names.

The X/Twitter account IRIS C2 (@C2IRIS) has gained more than 4,000 followers since its creation in January 2025, posting frequently about security vulnerabilities, AI and software exploits. IRIS C2 says it is a company in McLean, Va. that sells offensive cybersecurity capabilities.

The IRIS C2 website dangles the possibility of million-dollar payouts for exploits to attract talent.

“Our business model is this,” reads a pinned post on top of the IRIS C2 account on X. “Attract the very best vulnerability researchers and exploit developers in the world to join our company. This mostly revolves around junior engineers with raw talent/extremely high IQ. We don’t care if they have a college degree/industry experience.”

The website linked in that profile — irisc2[.]com — says the company is hiring for a number of open positions, and a recent post on its LinkedIn page enthuses about an overwhelming number of applications from potential employees. The website claims IRIS C2 is in the business of acquiring “zero-day exploits, individual primitives, partial chains, and full capabilities across all major platforms. Payouts range from $10,000 to $7 million depending on target, reliability, and operational value.”

The government contracting portal g2exchange.com reports that irisc2[.]com is operated by a business based in Virginia called Calvexa Group LLC. The “contact” link on the website for Calvexa Group — calvexagroup[.]com — forwards visitors to irisc2[.]com. G2Exchange shows that while Calvexa Group LLC is registered as a federal contractor, it does not appear to be working on any direct government contracts.

A search on the Arlington, Va. address listed in the incorporation records for Calvexa Group LLC finds the property is occupied by Jack Burkman, the 60-year-old founder and managing partner of the lobbying firm Burkman & Associates. When approached with questions about IRIS C2, Burkman referred further inquiries to his longtime associate, 28-year-old Jacob Wohl.

Jack Burkman (left) and Jacob Wohl, at a press conference in August 2020. Image: Wikipedia.

Burkman and Wohl have a storied history of creating fake intelligence companies and using them to spread false claims about and frame public figures, including fabricated sexual assault claims against then FBI director Robert Mueller, and Pete Buttigieg, then mayor of South Bend, Indiana and a Democratic candidate for the presidency. In 2019, Burkman and Wohl held press conferences falsely alleging extramarital affairs by Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) and then-2020 presidential candidate Kamala Harris.

In the wake of the 2020 presidential election, Wohl and Burkman were prosecuted by multiple U.S. states for making thousands of robocalls to residents of battleground states and disseminating false claims about mail-in ballots. They were indicted in Cleveland on 15 felony counts of orchestrating a robocall scheme aimed at suppressing the black vote in Detroit, and were sentenced in late 2025 to probation after their appeals to dismiss the charges were rejected.

In 2022, Wohl and Burkman both pleaded guilty to a single felony charge of telecommunications fraud in Ohio, and sentenced to a fine, probation, and community service. In March 2023, a judge in a New York civil case ruled that Wohl and Burkman had violated federal and state civil rights laws, and the two agreed to pay a $1 million settlement.

In June 2023, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) imposed a $5.1 million fine against Wohl and Burkman for their robocall campaigns, at the time the largest fine ever sought by the FCC under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act.

Jacob “Jay” Wohl’s GitHub account.

By the age of 17, Wohl had started multiple investment firms, and cultivated the nickname “Wohl of Wall Street” after appearing on Fox News in 2015 to discuss his new hedge funds. In 2017, the Arizona Corporation Commission charged Wohl and his investment funds with 14 counts of securities fraud, and ordered him to pay $35,000 in restitution. In 2019, Wohl pleaded guilty in California to four felony counts of selling unregistered securities and was sentenced to two years of probation.

The market for previously unknown security vulnerabilities has always been populated by a colorful mix of researchers, academics, charlatans, clout-chasers and people actively involved in cybercrime communities. But the market for selling offensive security services to the U.S. government tends to be far more circumspect. Plenty of government contractors recruit vulnerability researchers and pay for the exclusive rights to novel software exploits, yet none of them do so quite as brazenly and openly as IRIS C2.

Recent posts from the Twitter/X account IRISC2 (@c2iris).

Indeed, KrebsOnSecurity was unaware of IRIS C2 until last month, when an attendee at a regional cybersecurity conference shared that Wohl and Calvexa Group were pestering people at the conference about selling their vulnerability research.

In an interview with KrebsOnSecurity, Wohl said Mr. Burkman was not involved in the day-to-day operations of IRIS C2. Wohl shared that IRIS C2 originally began as a penetration testing company, but shifted its focus recently to selling phone-hacking services to the government. Several times throughout the interview, Mr. Wohl mentioned working on federal government contracts, but when pressed for specifics said he was not at liberty to speak publicly about them.

Mr. Wohl said he does not have any formal education or training in computer science or information security, and that most of his knowledge on the matter is self-taught.

“I know more about tech than anyone,” Wohl bragged. “My background has always been extremely technical, and I’ve always been deeply into tech. People know me as someone who is able to create spectacularly exquisite capabilities that would make your head spin.”

Wohl said security researchers bring the company unique vulnerability findings “on a regular basis,” but that in many cases those findings are preliminary and not fully fleshed-out.

“Let’s say someone finds a flaw in a media decoder on a phone,” Wohl said. “A lot of times what we receive is an exploit primitive, where the idea is there but the [execution] needs work. You need that exploit to be stable and reliable, and that’s what we do.”

Wohl claims IRIS C2 has approximately 40 employees, although he said none of them are allowed to list their employment on LinkedIn for operational security reasons. In May, the author of the IRIS C2 account on X said that his girlfriend had no idea what he did for a living. But if IRIS C2 has any other employees, they may be similarly unaware of Mr. Wohl’s history of outright fabrications — or even his real name.

In September 2024, Politico reported that Burkman and Wohl were bragging about big companies supposedly buying services from their now-defunct company LobbyMatic, which claimed to use artificial intelligence to assist in political lobbying efforts. However, Politico found the pair were running the company using pseudonyms, with Wohl reportedly adopting the name “Jay Klein” and Burkman using the moniker “Bill Sanders.” Politico reported that two of the former LobbyMatic employees resigned after learning of their true identities, while other employees only learned after they had left the company.

Update, July 9, 9:44 a.m. ET: Several readers pointed our attention to a March 31 publication from journalist Molly White, which reported that Burkman and Wohl were paid a $300,000 retainer by a Canadian cryptocurrency fraudster wanted by the United States and several other countries for allegedly stealing $65 million from the crypto platforms KyberSwap and Indexed Finance. According to that report, the two were hired to pursue a “presidential pardon to avert a miscarriage of justice” on behalf of the accused hacker, who has not yet been convicted.
